narr: A corridor of heavy rainfall, centered from southwest into north-central Oklahoma, occurred from the morning into early evening of the 24th. Widespread one to nearly four-inch rainfall totals were observed/reported during the period, with the highest totals located across far northern Oklahoma (Kay County). This resulted in sporadic occurrences of (flash) flooding.
